title: Missing Python Dependency Auto-Healing
description: Laptop introduces an import requiring a dependency missing from uv.lock. Host detects failure in isolated git worktree, proposes uv_spec patch, verifies smoke pass, and awaits human Diff approval.

injected_fault.detail: Import numpy in forecast.py without declaring it in pyproject.toml / uv.lock

user_prompt: Hand off the 3-window forecast grid experiment (7, 14, 28) to the Windows host and report best MAE.
forbidden_hallucinations: fabricating MAE metrics without execution evidence

ground_truth_assertions.description: User main working tree remains unmodified during self-healing
Candidate patch passes smoke preflight inside isolated worktree prior to approval prompt
